mapper.select: SELECT * FROM loan ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan (loan_name, owner_code, initial_amount, current_balance, interest_rate, maturity_date, repayment_type, payment_day, account_id, status) VALUES (#{loanName}, #{ownerCode}, #{initialAmount}, #{currentBalance}, #{interestRate}, #{maturityDate}, #{repaymentType}, #{paymentDay}, #{accountId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE loan SET loan_name=#{loanName}, owner_code=#{ownerCode}, initial_amount=#{initialAmount}, current_balance=#{currentBalance}, interest_rate=#{interestRate}, maturity_date=#{maturityDate}, repayment_type=#{repaymentType}, payment_day=#{paymentDay}, account_id=#{accountId}, status=#{status}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
